_readme: The PUBLISHED schedule you read off your IQM Resonance account, entered by
hand (IQM has no schedule API). It's used to split observed downtime into
'scheduled' vs the 'unscheduled' outages you actually care about.
An outage overlapping one is tagged 'scheduled'.
available_24_7     : true if the device is meant to be online around the clock.
available_windows  : recurring weekly windows it's meant to be up, UTC.
If a device has no entry here it's assumed 24/7 online, so any OFFLINE is
'unscheduled'. Delete the example below and add your real devices.

maintenance.note: EXAMPLE — replace with the real calibration/maintenance window you read off Resonance
